name: Sicilian Defense
description: The Sicilian Defense is a popular chess opening starting with 1.e4 c5. It leads to sharp, asymmetrical play where Black fights for the center using the c-pawn.

name: French Defense
description: The French Defense starts with 1.e4 e6. Black prepares to challenge White's center with d5. It leads to closed, strategic positions.

name: Ruy Lopez
description: The Ruy Lopez starts with 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5. It is one of the oldest and most thoroughly analyzed chess openings, focusing on classical center control.

name: Italian Game
description: The Italian Game starts with 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4. It is one of the oldest opening systems, focusing on rapid piece development, center control, and targeting Black's weak f7-square.

name: Caro-Kann Defense
description: The Caro-Kann Defense is a solid, resilient opening starting with 1.e4 c6. Black prepares to support the center with d5, aiming for structural stability and positional play.

name: Queen's Gambit
description: The Queen's Gambit starts with 1.d4 d5 2.c4. White offers a flank pawn to deflect Black's d5 pawn and establish strong control over the center of the board.

name: King's Indian Defense
pgn: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 Bg7
description: The King's Indian Defense starts with 1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 g6 3.Nc3 Bg7. A dynamic, hypermodern opening where Black allows White center control early to strike back later from the flanks.

name: Scotch Game
description: The Scotch Game starts with 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4. White immediately challenges Black in the center of the board, leading to an open game with rapid tactical skirmishes.

name: Scandinavian Defense
description: The Scandinavian Defense starts with 1.e4 d5. Black immediately attacks White's e4 pawn on the first move, forcing open lines and active queen play.

name: Slav Defense
description: The Slav Defense starts with 1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6. A highly solid defense against the Queen's Gambit, where Black supports the d5 pawn while keeping the light-squared bishop active.

name: English Opening
description: The English Opening starts with 1.c4. A flank opening where White fights for the d5-square from the side, leading to strategic and flexible middlegames.
